antecēdō

antecēdō, antecēdere, antecessī, antecessum

verb, third conjugation

go before, go ahead of; surpass, excel

In this lexicon

  • go before

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Off. 1.105: quantum nātūra hominis pecudibus antecēdit (Lewis & Short); Caes. BG 7.35: magnīs itineribus antecessit (Lewis & Short)

Examples

  • quantum nātūra hominis pecudibus antecēdit
